findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` instead of rejecting the cross-tenant read. Because this exported function is an authorization gate, the change permits one tenant to access another tenant’s documents. Restore the tenant comparison or an equivalent isolation check.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document access
findings.body:
`canReadDocument("tenant-a", "tenant-b")` now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads wherever this exported function is used as the authorization gate. This is a direct authorization bypass and can disclose one tenant’s documents to another.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally authorizes a user to read documents belonging to any tenant. Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` now bypasses the previous cross-tenant access restriction, potentially exposing sensitive tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
